# University of Toronto Mississauga

> UTM is a comprehensive Canadian research university campus serving future students, current students, graduate students, faculty, staff, and alumni with admissions, academic programs, student support services, and campus resources.

UTM is the Mississauga campus of the University of Toronto, offering undergraduate and graduate programs with a focus on student success, equity and inclusion, mental health support, and community engagement. The site serves as the primary hub for admissions, registration, student services, and campus life information.

## Key Topics

- Admissions & Future Students
- Undergraduate Programs
- Graduate Students
- Course Enrollment & Registration
- Financial Aid & Scholarships
- Student Support Services
- Mental Health Resources
- International Students
- Faculty & Staff Resources
- Equity, Diversity & Inclusion
- Campus Life & Events
- Alumni Engagement
- Co-op & Internships
- Campus Tours
- ACORN (Student Portal)

## Admissions & Future Students

- [University of Toronto Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca): UTM homepage with admissions, programs, campus tours, and scholarships
- [Future Students](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/future-students): Admissions, undergraduate programs, campus visits, and application process
- [New Students](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/new-students): Orientation programs, pre-arrival guides, and first-year essentials for new students

## Student Services & Academic Support

- [Current Students | University of Toronto Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/current-students): Student services, academic resources, and campus life for current students
- [Office of the Registrar](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/registrar): Student registration, course enrollment, academic calendar, and financial aid
- [Mental Health Supports](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/mental-health-supports): Mental health crisis resources, counseling, and Telus Health student support
- [International Education Centre](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/international): International student support, immigration advising, and global learning programs

## Graduate & Advanced Programs

- [Graduate Students](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/grad-students): Graduate programs, resources, and support for master's and graduate students

## Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

- [Equity Hub | Equity, Diversity & Inclusion Office](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/edio/equity-hub): UTM Equity, Diversity & Inclusion Office resources and activities hub

## Faculty, Staff & Employment

- [Faculty & Staff | University of Toronto Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/faculty-staff): Faculty and staff resources, HR, technical support, and career development
- [Human Resources](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/human-resources): HR resources, employment opportunities, payroll, benefits, and staff development
- [Wellbeing and Belonging Committee at U of T Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/faculty-staff/wellbeing-and-belonging-committee-u-t-mississauga): Employee wellness, belonging initiatives, and campus culture support
- [Childcare Resources | University of Toronto Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/faculty-staff/childcare-resources): On-campus childcare, Early Learning Centre, and financial childcare support

## Alumni & Community

- [Alumni](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/alumni): Alumni community engagement, events, and networking for 78,000+ graduates

## Campus & Visitor Information

- [Visitors | University of Toronto Mississauga](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/about-us/contact-us/maps-directions): Campus directions, parking, public transit, and visitor information
- [Parking](https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/parking): Campus parking permits, visitor parking, and transportation information
